'No model has ever solved 198 of the 898 tasks' matches the verbatim OpenAI quote; the 30-40% unsolvable estimate and the disagreement are kept in note 2. 'Some tasks have no solution' is softened in the panel to 'no known way to the flag'.
The 26 Jun agent board message is shown in braces and labelled 'paraphrased by METR', consistent with quotes.md row 5; the single-paraphrase caveat sits in note 3.

'No agent messages from 26 Jun to 6 Jul survive: investigators saw no board activity in that window, and the rebuild wiped the board' combines METR's no-activity finding with OpenAI's rebuild; METR's 'likely because' hedge appears only in note 3. Borderline but scoped to the board by the tile label.
The claim that training strategies recurred in evaluation is OpenAI's account; note 1 caveats that no outside party verified it.

rationale: Every visible claim traces to a cited source in the pack, and quoted or paraphrased material carries the correct status label. Attribution and uncertainty caveats (disputed task count, single paraphrase, unverified training account, METR's hedge) sit in the reader notes. The fact tile's phrasing is slightly more definite than METR's hedge, but it does not add detail, widen scope or make a certainty claim that the combined sources fail to support.
